job.job_description:
Work on designing and developing LLM-driven AI systems with focus on agentic workflows, prompt engineering, and scalable cloud-based deployment. Responsible for building intelligent pipelines, optimizing model performance, and integrating AI solutions into SaaS platforms.
Design and develop applications using Large Language Models (LLMs)
Build and manage agentic AI workflows and multi-step reasoning pipelines
Develop prompt engineering strategies for optimized AI responses
Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines with vector databases
Optimize LLM performance, latency, and cost efficiency
Create AI system flowcharts, architecture diagrams, and design documents
Integrate LLMs with backend systems and cloud platforms
Experiment with open-source and proprietary AI models for various use cases
Develop APIs and services for AI model interaction
Monitor, evaluate, and improve AI model outputs and accuracy
B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related field
Candidates must have 1 to 2 years of experience in AI/ML development, with a focus on LLMs and generative AI models.
Candidates must have basic knowledge on LLM and Pytorch and Hugging Face Interface.
Strong experience in Python and AI/ML development
Hands-on experience with LLMs and Generative AI models
Knowledge of RAG architectures and vector databases
Experience in model optimization and performance tuning
Understanding of NLP, deep learning, and transformer models
Experience with frameworks like LangChain or similar
Ability to design AI workflows, flowcharts, and system architecture
Strong problem-solving and experimentation skills
